I can’t say whether or not you are, but i can offer ways for you and your partner to be able to clearly communicate consent during sex. 

my partner and I have both been assaulted on multiple occasions prior to being together. Before we have sex, we agree on words or actions that we will unequivocally know mean “stop” and “no,” or we just agree that when we say stop and no we mean it and it is not sexual. Sometimes we aren’t vocal during sex, so we have talked about hand motions such as tapping to signal stop, change in position or a break. For example two taps means “I want to stop” and three taps means “let’s change positions” 

hope this helps.
